latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the coingecko skill, enabling comprehensive access to CoinGecko and GeckoTerminal APIs for live cryptocurrency market data.

- Supports requests for real-time crypto prices, market caps, trading volume, historical data, exchanges, DEXes, NFTs, and DeFi statistics.
- Strictly enforces use of live API data for all market figures—never answers with outdated or memorized training information.
- Guides users through credential checks and API tier requirements before proceeding with any data request, helping avoid silent failures.
- Handles API key setup, rate limits, error diagnostics, and offers clear user instructions if data retrieval fails.
- Triggers automatically on any relevant crypto query, even if CoinGecko isn’t explicitly mentioned.
